_head: The measurements behind this folder's tokens, replayable. The source is a screen recording whose camera zooms and pans, so there is no one capture and no one scale: each probe names its own `pt`. p1 is cam0, a frame the camera holds the whole 440 x 956 screen in, at 1.4455 px/pt, and its boxes are screen pt. a155 is camA at 3.7818 px/pt, holding screen pt 0..410, so its boxes are screen pt too. b310 and b360 are camB at 3.6114 px/pt, holding screen pt 519.6..956, so THEIR BOXES ARE SCREEN PT MINUS 519.6 -- the capture's own origin. The captures are third-party and assets/refs/ is not committed, so rebuild them before replaying: cut the frames out of the recording, then cut each to the screen at the geometry in gen.py's header. --against wants a directory holding the four boards rendered with --crop-phone --phone-size 440x956 and then resampled to each capture's own pixel size and window; scratch/fit.py does that, and every probe names its file there. The photo stacks, the story avatars and the header avatar are original art rather than the source's pictures, so the probes over them measure geometry only and never colour.
